$comment: Wierzchowce w kłusie (tools/animate-mounts.mjs, PixelLab animate-with-text-v3). start: wybrany obrazek wierzchowca z art/drafts/mounts, przycięty i postawiony na płótnie z miejscem na ruch nóg, przodem w prawo. Jeźdźcy siadają na nich później (tools/ride-sheets.py). trot: wybrane klatki szkicu w kolejności pętli, miejsce siodła w pierwszej z nich, klatki na sekundę i poprawki (clean); z nich tools/mount-trots.py robi arkusz kłusu do sceny Walki i wpis w data/animations.json.
action: trotting at a steady pace in place, seen from the side and facing right, the four legs moving in a smooth seamless trot loop, the head and body bobbing slightly, the saddle and bridle stay in place

pony.description: a small stocky piebald pony, brown with white patches, a white blaze, a brown leather saddle on a dark red saddle cloth and a leather bridle with reins

horse.description: a bay riding horse with a black mane, tail and lower legs, a brown leather saddle on a dark red saddle cloth and a leather bridle with reins

steed.description: a big steel-blue warhorse with a long black mane and tail, white socks, a dark leather saddle on a blue saddle cloth with silver trim and a bridle with silver studs

sabertooth.description: a huge saber-toothed tiger with orange fur, black stripes and two long curved fangs, a dark leather saddle on a fur saddle cloth with bone trinkets and a leather bridle with reins, and a long striped tail with a black tip
sabertooth.action: walking at a steady pace in place like a big cat, seen from the side and facing right, the four legs moving in a smooth seamless walk loop, the head and body swaying slightly, the tail swaying, the saddle and bridle stay in place
